data.title: Americans vote in midterms set to upend Trump presidency
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Americans deliver their verdict on Donald Trump's tumultuous second presidency Tuesday in midterm elections that threaten to shatter his grip on Washington, with Democrats poised to seize the House and challenge for control of the Senate.

data.title: Multinational Ukraine force to hold first exercise in Poland
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Some 2,800 troops from 10 European countries will this month stage in Poland the first exercise of a new multinational force in support of Ukraine, London and Paris said on Tuesday.

data.title: Trial of accused USS Cole attack mastermind opens at Guantanamo
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Jury selection began on Monday in the long-delayed trial of Abd al-Rahim al-Nashiri, the accused mastermind of the 2000 attack on the USS Cole warship that left 17 American sailors dead.

data.title: Top Arab-Israeli leader tells AFP opposition must join to oust Netanyahu
data.description: NAZARETH (ISRAEL) - The leader of the largest Arab-majority party in the incoming Israeli parliament told AFP on Monday that it was time for reluctant opposition members to accept "political reality" and join forces to unseat Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

data.title: Caught cold: fridge cyberattack highlights internet gadget weaknesses
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Cyberattacks affecting supermarket refrigeration systems in several European countries on Monday highlighted the risks associated with connecting industrial equipment to the internet.

data.title: Prayers, anticipation await Pope Leo in Argentine care home
data.description: CLAYPOLE (ARGENTINA) - A home for disabled people on the outskirts of Buenos Aires was full of anticipation as it prepared to receive Pope Leo XIV, amid a growing controversy over state assistance for those with special needs in Argentina.

data.title: Ukraine, Russia see emergency alert systems hacked
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Emergency alert systems in Russia and Ukraine were hit in cyber attacks overnight leading into Monday, with fake warnings of possible nuclear strikes broadcast to users in both countries.

data.title: Belgian PM offers to quit over budget impasse
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever tendered his resignation to King Philippe on Monday over deadlocked budget talks, but the monarch deferred his decision until after a new meeting Friday.

data.title: Russia resumes strikes on Kherson after truce ends
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russia resumed strikes on the southern Ukrainian city of Kherson on Monday after the end of a local ceasefire in the area -- the longest truce in the war raging between the neighbours since 2022 -- Kyiv said.

data.title: Israel army withdraws after Hebron operation
data.description: HEBRON (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Israeli troops withdrew on Monday from an area of the occupied West Bank's largest city that they had evacuated of its Palestinian residents, following an attack that killed two soldiers in October.

data.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police protesting higher wages
data.description: ASHULIA — Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers blocked a major highway and clashed with police on Monday, demanding a monthly minimum wage more than double their current pay, as protests spread across industrial hubs.

data.title: Limited French school protests resume as holidays end
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French students returning from autumn holidays blocked some high schools on Monday, determined to reinvigorate a protest movement despite government concessions during the break.

data.title: Irish bookshops help meet UK demand for Sally Rooney novels
data.description: LONDONDERRY (UNITED KINGDOM) - Irish bookshops are helping readers in Britain and elsewhere obtain novels by Sally Rooney after her publisher halted UK supplies because of complications arising from the author's support for a pro-Palestinian group.

data.title: Malaysia Airlines says customers may be affected by Amadeus breach
data.description: Malaysia Airlines has said that some customer information may have been affected ‌by a cybersecurity incident involving Amadeus, its reservation-technology provider.

data.title: Years after Islamic State's defeat, French jihadists face justice in Iraq
data.description: BAGHDAD - A decade ago, the Islamic State group broadcast its crimes as it recruited radicals from around the world and imposed a brutal system of oppression across swathes of Syria and Iraq.

data.title: Cathay Pacific says data from 53,000 bookings compromised in Amadeus cyberattack
data.description: Hong Kong flag carrier Cathay Pacific Airways has revealed that personal data and flight details of 53,000 bookings were compromised after hackers breached its technology service provider's system.

data.title: South Korea to double spending on AI and chips in 2027
data.description: SEOUL — South Korea will double spending on artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductors in 2027 to a record high, the president said Monday, pledging to use the technology to turn the military into a "smart, elite force".

data.title: Hong Kong beautician gets 4 years for selling friends to Myanmar scam hub
data.description: A Hong Kong beautician has been sentenced to four years in jail for tricking two friends into forced labour and confinement in Myanmar's notorious "KK Park" scam farm, with a judge slamming her actions as "vicious and inhumane".

data.title: Nine people dead in Learjet crash in south Florida
data.description: Private ​jet had taken off ⁠from Austin, ⁠Texas and headed to Bahamas, ​FAA says, as NTSB has launched investigation into crash

data.title: Violence after Germany's 'Gen Z' demos slammed by politicians
data.description: FRANKFURT — Multiple German politicians on Sunday criticised clashes and looting the day before on the margins of youth-led demonstrations, though several also warned that the acts should not eclipse the protesters' demands.

data.title: Iran warns new war could last longer after Trump threatens strikes
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran warned on Sunday that any renewed war with the United States could last longer than the previous round of fighting, after President Donald Trump said he still had to "take care" of more targets.

data.title: Israel elections chief says inquiry into irregularities will not undermine result
data.description: JERUSALEM - The head of Israel's Central Elections Committee said on Sunday that an ongoing investigation into alleged foreign funding in the country's recent vote would not call into question its result, noting that so far "suspicions remain suspicions".

data.title: Tens of thousands protest in India's capital against voter roll revision
data.description: NEW DELHI (INDIA) - Tens of thousands joined a protest led by opposition politicians in India's capital on Sunday, renewing demands for the country's election chief to resign over an overhaul of voter lists they say unfairly benefits the ruling party.

data.title: France launches 'attempted murder' probe after petrol bomb attack on security forces
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France has launched an attempted murder investigation after petrol bombs were thrown at security forces during a weekend protest in Paris, prosecutors told AFP on Sunday.

data.title: Thousands protest in India's capital against voter roll revision
data.description: NEW DELHI (INDIA) - Thousands joined a protest led by opposition politicians in India's capital on Sunday, renewing demands for the country's election chief to resign over an overhaul of voter lists they say unfairly benefits the ruling party.

data.title: Hackers post porn on LED billboards 'to expose security weaknesses'
data.description: Hackers who hijacked LED billboards in Malaysia and posted pornographic videos said they were exposing security weaknesses, not looking to extort victims or distribute ransomware.

data.title: Binance says resuming withdrawals after major hack
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Binance said Sunday that it had resumed withdrawals after a major hack that affected more than $6 billion in funds.

data.title: Divided Bulgaria votes in tense presidential runoff
data.description: SOFIA (BULGARIA) - Bulgarians started voting Sunday in a presidential runoff between two candidates with contrasting visions on the war in Ukraine, following a series of drone attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea.

data.title: Trump says US looking 'closely' at report Nvidia CEO target of China spy plot
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump voiced on Saturday his support for the "brilliant" head of US chip giant Nvidia, Jensen Huang after a report he was targeted by a Chinese spy plot.

data.title: Spewing US election falsehoods, AI chatbots face scrutiny
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Dispensing misleading voter information, misidentifying candidates, and regurgitating Russian propaganda, AI chatbots are sowing information chaos ahead of the US midterm elections, researchers say.

data.title: 'Seen and heard': Uruguay neighborhood places hopes in pope
data.description: MONTEVIDEO - In one impoverished neighborhood of Uruguay's capital, Catholics and evangelical Christians are unusually harmonious ahead of Pope Leo XIV's visit, with both communities viewing it as an opportunity to shed light on local suffering.

data.title: Pope Leo readies for 'intense' South America homecoming
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV is about to embark on one of the most ambitious papal foreign trips in decades, touring Uruguay, Argentina and his adopted homeland Peru, despite recent lung cancer surgery.
